title: He Jumped From 25,000 Feet With No Parachute. He Landed in a Net

scenes.text: A man jumped from 25,000 feet with no parachute.
On July 30, 2016, skydiver Luke Aikins stepped out of a plane.
Below him was one target: a net, 100 feet by 100 feet.
He fell for about two minutes, at around 120 miles an hour.
Right before impact, he flipped onto his back, as planned.
He landed safely. A net the size of a third of a football field.

description:
In 2016, skydiver Luke Aikins jumped from 25,000 feet with no parachute.
He landed in a net 100 feet by 100 feet and walked away.
Would you ever do it?
first_comment: No parachute, 25,000 feet. Would you do it, yes or no?
